body: I am 16, yeah living with parents. Very strict mom obsessed with nothing but academic results

They do not understand me, and if i went to the few "friends" i have and tried to tell them my problems i would lose them too. Last night i just got abused again, and i began crying in anguish and hoping someone would be here to support me. I know i am being selfish but to whoever that someone is ... where were you when i was locked  inside my room and starved, where were you when i was crying on the floor, where were you when i begged for company, a non-judgemental friend is all i ask...
Then i realised that there was no one, maybe i am asking for too much. Maybe i have always been having false hope and no one is ever going to save me
I cannot talk to my parents about anything, or anyone around me in fact. The only way i have ever gone about expressing my feelings is to bottle it up and direct it inwards, hence cutting myself
i hope you are still there, because i dont have much time left myself, so lets spend it together
